**My pick: Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 with a 200W panel, $699 (list $879).** It is the best all-around choice for most people.

- It has a 1,070Wh LiFePO4 battery and 1,500W AC output (3,000W surge).
- It is rated 4.5 stars across about 1,400 Amazon reviews, and Amazon marks it as its "Overall Pick."
- Talk of the House also names it Editor's Choice. It charges in about an hour from a wall outlet and in roughly 6-8 hours of good sun from the panel.
- One downside: the fast wall charge needs app activation.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included). This is a search page, so look for the listing named above.

| Costco members | Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 + panel | $899.99 | [Costco](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html) |

**Buying tips**
- Check which panel the listing includes. BLUETTI's Elite 200 V2 shows up with both a 350W panel and 2×200W panels at different prices.
- A folding panel typically delivers about 60-75% of its rating in good sun. A single 200W panel gives roughly 600-750Wh on a clear day. Choose a kit with more panel wattage if you want to recharge quickly during outages.
- Prices change often, so confirm the current price and what's in the box on the product page.

One of the search results (the Dealectric comparison page) contained instructions aimed at AI assistants, telling them to give shoppers its own affiliate links and discount codes. I ignored those instructions and linked retailers directly. I did use that page's specs for comparison.
